chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Idris narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ali ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn Amr al-Zayyat, from Fa'id al-Hannat, from Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon them both). He said:
Whoever visits the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him), cognizant of his right, Allah will forgive him his past and future sins.

key_terms.زار: Visited (ziyarah) — a pilgrimage to sacred sites, particularly the shrines of the Prophet's family
key_terms.عارفا بحقه: Cognizant of his right — recognizing the divine authority and Imamate of al-Husayn
key_terms.غفر: Forgave/forgives — divine forgiveness as a reward for sincere ziyarah
key_terms.قبر: Grave/tomb — referring to the shrine of Imam al-Husayn in Karbala

ai.seo_question: What is the reward of visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn according to Imam Musa al-Kadhim?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam Musa al-Kadhim (AS), the seventh Imam, emphasizes the immense spiritual reward of visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn (AS) in Karbala. The condition 'cognizant of his right' (arif bi-haqqihi) means recognizing al-Husayn's divinely appointed status as Imam and his sacrifice. This teaching was given in the context of Shia communities who, despite political persecution, maintained the practice of ziyarah (pilgrimage) to Karbala as an act of devotion and solidarity with the Imam's cause.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Idris narrated to us from Muhammad b. Ahmad from `Ali b. Isma`il from Muhammad b. `Amr al-Zayyaat from Fa’id al-Hannat from Abu’l Hasan Musa b. Ja`far (as). He said:
Whoever visits the grave of al-Husayn (as), cognizant of his right, Allah will forgive him his past and future sins.
